## Notes

- **Standing constraints (carried):** ui changesets go to the root `.changeset/`. No PR goes to the objectui repository. `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` gates every ui card. Cloud-touching cards go whole to the `repo:cloud` lane. `ui/.github/**` and the root `ci.yml` stay ⛔ out of bounds for ui cards. `@object-ui/app-shell` is `private`, so its changes ship under `@object-ui/console`.
- **Clause-② for i18n keys:** `@object-ui/i18n` exports `en` and `TranslationKeys = typeof en`, and its `./namespaces/*` subpaths are published. So an added pack key is `Clause-②: yes (widening)`.
- **Write path:** the relay (`post-stamped.mjs`, `label-write.mjs`, `issue-create.mjs`, `fleet-write/dispatch.mjs`). ⛔ No GitHub MCP writes.
- **Publication:** objectstack. A merge to `main` publishes nothing. The release is the Version Packages PR, which a person merges.
